text_block_list.text:
On the morning after the break, I was 
summoned by King Halo.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Could you go grab my bag from the 
entrance?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...And while you're at it, I'll give you 
the privilege of carrying that bag to the 
classroom.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sleepy, and my body feels heavy... 
Times like this are when you're supposed 
to make yourself useful...
